aiStatement: The model works with the context its app supplies—not automatically with every past conversation.
analogy: Your pilot has trained expertise; yesterday's briefing comes aboard only if the app includes it.
agent: The app supplies context for each model request

you-are-the-captain.title: You are the captain
you-are-the-captain.script: Imagine you work with an AI model that is brilliant at its job, the most capable colleague you have. I will give it a picture, because we need one all the way down: you are the captain of a coastal research project, and the model is your pilot of ten years, who steers a diving robot on a cable from the control room on deck while you decide where the project goes next.

one-settled-condition.title: One settled condition
one-settled-condition.script: For this thought experiment, the pilot keeps the expertise from training but carries no briefing from one dive to the next. Real products may add conversation history or saved memory; the model works with the context its app supplies for this request.
